stage_progress.title: Runtime telemetry baseline
goals: inventory and converge existing Pulse, Horizon and runtime evidence ownership
define one operational metric vocabulary with explicit freshness and unavailable semantics
reuse bounded read-only Project Kernel/Admin/CLI surfaces without request-time source scans

stage_progress.title: Provider and data-pipeline health
goals: compose provider failures, freshness, ingestion/import and quarantine health without moving provider evidence into canonical authority
define stable operational failure classes and timestamps for degraded data pipelines

stage_progress.title: Scale scorecard and decision thresholds
goals: compose runtime, queue, database, cache, provider and search visibility evidence into a measurable scale scorecard
require metric thresholds and expected improvement before recommending infrastructure changes

stage_progress.title: External observability evaluation and stage closure
goals: evaluate external observability only against demonstrated internal gaps and security/cost constraints
close Stage 24 through existing exact-head verification and canonical closure ownership

work_lease_policy.authority: live Git branch + GitHub pull request
work_lease_policy.rule: Never store volatile PR/head state as authored progress. AI must resolve the live branch/PR before writing; an existing active PR for the same semantic owner is resumed instead of duplicated. Stage work uses one umbrella branch while logical tranche ownership remains explicit in this plan.
